title: [SOA] Clarify contact mapping options for unknown email senders
summary: The contact-link dialog for unmatched email senders now clearly separates task-level contact overrides from updating contact data, shows the sender's email address, explains that matching uses both E-Mail and E-Mail 2, and spells out the E-Mail 2 replacement values.
key_points: Dialog now shows the unmatched sender's email address
Clarifies the difference between a task-level contact override and updating contact data
Explains that matching checks both E-Mail and E-Mail 2
E-Mail 2 replacement confirmation shows the field, current value and replacement value
Caption-only change; matching logic and option ordering are unchanged
quote: Improve the contact-link dialog shown when an email sender does not match an existing contact.
